_source: myWalletTransactions -> MyWalletTransactionsResponse { success, message, error, metadata, data: [WalletTransactionEntity!] }. WalletTransactionEntity introspected live: amountVnd:Int!, createdAt!, id!, note, paymentId, type:WalletTransactionType!, updatedAt!, wallet. No relations loaded, so `wallet` is null on the wire. Rows are ordered createdAt DESC by the handler. WalletTransactionType has exactly two members, deposit and spend, so the sign of a line is a TYPE rather than a negative number - amountVnd is always the magnitude, and a screen that rendered a minus sign would be inventing one. `note` is operator text and may be absent; it is not a translated string and must not be treated as one.
